WITH max_dt AS (
  SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp))::date AS max_month_start
  FROM orders o
),
months AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    (m.max_month_start - INTERVAL '23 months')::date,
    m.max_month_start::date,
    INTERVAL '1 month'
  )::date AS month_start
  FROM max_dt m
),
payments_per_order AS (
  SELECT
    op.order_id,
    ABS(SUM(op.payment_value)) AS order_payment_total
  FROM order_payments op
  GROUP BY op.order_id
),
order_price_totals AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_id,
    ABS(SUM(oi.price)) AS order_price_total
  FROM order_items oi
  GROUP BY oi.order_id
),
item_alloc AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_id,
    oi.product_id,
    COALESCE(pct.product_category_name_english, 'Unknown') AS category_name,
    DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp)::date AS month_start,
    -- allocate payment value to item proportionally by item price within the order
    CASE
      WHEN opt.order_price_total > 0 THEN (pp.order_payment_total * (ABS(oi.price) / opt.order_price_total))
      ELSE 0
    END AS allocated_payment
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN payments_per_order pp ON pp.order_id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN order_price_totals opt ON opt.order_id = oi.order_id
  LEFT JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  LEFT JOIN product_category_translation pct ON pct.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
  WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= (SELECT (max_month_start - INTERVAL '23 months')::date FROM max_dt)
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp <  ((SELECT max_month_start FROM max_dt) + INTERVAL '1 month')
),
category_month_sales AS (
  SELECT
    category_name,
    month_start,
    ABS(SUM(allocated_payment)) AS monthly_sales
  FROM item_alloc
  GROUP BY category_name, month_start
),
top_categories AS (
  SELECT category_name
  FROM (
    SELECT category_name, SUM(monthly_sales) AS total_sales
    FROM category_month_sales
    GROUP BY category_name
    ORDER BY total_sales DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) t
),
category_month_grid AS (
  SELECT tc.category_name, m.month_start
  FROM top_categories tc
  CROSS JOIN months m
)
SELECT
  cmg.category_name,
  TO_CHAR(cmg.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS year_month,
  COALESCE(cms.monthly_sales, 0)::numeric(18,2) AS monthly_sales
FROM category_month_grid cmg
LEFT JOIN category_month_sales cms
  ON cms.category_name = cmg.category_name
  AND cms.month_start = cmg.month_start
ORDER BY cmg.category_name, cmg.month_start;
